content.rendered:
Passenger broke through in 2012 with his global hit, “Let Her Go.” About two years later, he covered Bruce’s “The River” during a promotional appearance at SiriusXM.

Passenger’s gentle singer-songwriter vibe is well-suited for the quieter side of Bruce’s catalog, and his stripped-down, acoustic approach to “The River” captures its melancholia in sharp black and white.

(Gotta admit, though, I’m a bit distracted by the checkered-shirt dude in the background. About halfway through, he seems to get lost in the song.)

© October 5, 2018

excerpt.rendered: Passenger stops by SiriusXM’s Studios and performs a stripped-down cover of “The River.”

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, River City Extension: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Start your morning off with a cool groove: watch River City Extension put their unique spin on Bruce's "Hungry Heart."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Tom Wopat: Meeting Across the River
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The former Dukes of Hazard star tackles Bruce's noir classic, and it's way better than that sentence would lead you to expect.

jetpack-related-posts.title: The Clarks: The River
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Clarks transform "The River" from ballad to full-on rocker, and it works--better than one might imagine was possible.

jetpack-related-posts.title: X Ambassadors: Stolen Car
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: From March 2018, the X Ambassadors prove their fandom by delivering a fantastic, moody cover of Bruce's "Stolen Car."

jetpack-related-posts.title: No Money Down
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: You've heard snippets in River-era bootlegs, but if you haven't heard the one and only recording of Bruce's full cover of "No Money Down" from way back in 1974, you need to listen to this definitive version inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Minnie Driver: Hungry Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Minnie Driver's cover of "Hungry Heart" is more lush and romantic than Bruce's lyrics call for, but then again so was Bruce's original arrangement. Take a listen to her lovely version inside.
